To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
R factor spectra of SSP model is dependent on the ductility and period,and can be expressed as the multiplication of ductility, damping and post yield factors.
The most important factor affecting the seismic response of the shear-skip hysteretic model is the structural ductility.
R spectra of the SSP model can be simplified to be a product of the ductility factor, the damping factor, the post-yield stiffness factor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the seismic design spectrum of the SSP model and provides a theoretical basis for the seismic design of the structure with SSP model.
the effect of energy dissipation capacity on seismic force modification factor.
the seismic design of structures with SSP model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the seismic force modification factors for structures with SSP hysteretic model are similar to that for structures with EPP hysteretic model.
the R factor is a function of the ductility,period,site type, damping and post yield ratio.
the ductility and post yield stiffness ratio are the most important parameters for the determination of R factor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the seismic design of the SSP model can be based on the R spectra proposed in this paper,which is a simple and effective way.
the seismic force modification factors of the SSP model are similar to those of the EPP model,except for the effect of energy dissipating capacity.
the seismic force modification factors for the SSP hysteretic model are similar with those for the EPP model in the low period range,but they are different in the high period range.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the R-factor is a function of the structural ductility and period,and the energy-dissipat-ing capacity has a beneficial effect on R factor in the short period region.
the SSP model has a better energy-dissipative capacity than the EPP model,and the R factor of SSP model is smaller than EPP model.
the R factor of SSP system is dependent on the ductility,energy-dissipating capability and the period T.
